images.title: Drag a dot, the mean follows
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the dot plot explorer: dragging one dot to the right pulls the mean to the right.
images.composition: One large number line; one dot is shown being dragged right, and the balance triangle slides right with it. Faded grey ghosts mark where the dot and the triangle were. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A number line from 9 to 22 with 14 evenly spaced short ticks, one at every whole number. Numerals appear only under the ticks at 10, 11, 17 and 21; all other ticks have no numerals. Three teal (#0072B2) dots: two stacked at 10, one at 11. One pale grey (#6B7280, light) ghost dot at 17 and one solid teal dot at 21, joined by a curved grey arrow from 17 to 21. Under the line, a pale grey ghost triangle at 12 with the label 'mean 12' below it, and a solid reddish purple (#CC79A7) triangle at 13 with the label 'mean 13' below it, joined by a short grey arrow from 12 to 13. Exactly 4 solid dots, 1 ghost dot, 2 triangles (1 ghost, 1 solid), 2 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Moving a value up pulls the mean up; the balance point always follows the dots.
